name: Dream Hunter Remu -Hypnos no Machi-
original_name: ドリームハンター麗夢 ヒュプノスの街
source:
Ayanokouji Reimu arrived at a dog town at late night. A town where dream and fact collided. Reimu soon comes to know the truth about the city...... She is violated by people in the town! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE024360.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
深夜，绫小路灵梦来到了狗镇。梦想与现实碰撞的小镇。灵梦很快就知道了这座城市的真相……她被镇上的人侵犯了！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE024360.html]DLsite English[/url]]
